sentences.text:
For the Petitioners : Mr. Vipul Poddar, Advocate
Mrs. Sugandha Jaiswal Poddar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Priya Shreshtha, Special P.P. For the
Informant : Mr. Anjani Kumar, Advocate

Instant petition has been filed for quashing of entire criminal
proceeding initiated against the petitioners in connection with Chakradharpur P.S. Case No.132 of
2019 corresponding to G.R. No.56 of 2020 for offence under Sections 498A and 504/34 of the
Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act pending in the Court of learned
S.D.J.M., Porahat at Chaibasa, West Singhbhum.

It is submitted by learned counsel on behalf of petitioners that the matter has been amicably settled and compromise petition has been filed by way of I.A. No..6597 of 2023 duly signed by the informant and her husband, who is petitioner no.1 in the present case.
The matter was referred to Mediation Centre at JHALSA and the copy of report is annexed with the interlocutory application regarding settlement by mutual consent in Cr. Revision No.1204 of 2022.
Learned counsel on behalf of informant has not disputed the assertions made by learned counsel on behalf of petitioners.
